summary: Defines the data fields and data types for In situ Operations, Administration, and Maintenance, a way to record operational and telemetry information inside packets as they travel a path. The fields can be carried in several encapsulations, such as NSH, Segment Routing, Geneve, or IPv6. It complements probe-based tools like ICMP. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Each packet carries a travel diary and every stop it passes writes a note, so you can see where it was slow.

questions: how to measure per hop delay inside packets
